title: feat: implement CLI plugin system with Zod-first protocol schema
body:
Adds extensible plugin architecture to ObjectStack CLI, enabling command extensions without core package modifications. Supports P0 roadmap features (scaffolding, migration, code generation) through distributed plugin packages.

## Architecture

**Protocol Schema** (`@objectstack/spec/cli`)
- Zod schemas for plugin manifests, commands, and runtime context
- Recursive subcommand support with lazy evaluation
- Lifecycle hooks (`onLoad`, `onUnload`) for resource management

**Plugin Discovery**
- Multi-location search: `~/.objectstack/plugins/`, `./.objectstack/plugins/`, `node_modules/`
- Symlink resolution via `fs.stat()` for development workflows
- Naming convention: `cli-plugin-*` prefix required

**Runtime Context**
- Logger, config manager, package manager detection
- File I/O and command execution utilities
- Configuration persistence in `~/.objectstack/config.json`

## Plugin Example

```typescript
import type { CLIPlugin } from '@objectstack/spec/cli';

const plugin: CLIPlugin = {
  metadata: {
    id: '@org/cli-plugin-scaffold',
    name: 'Scaffold Plugin',
    version: '1.0.0',
    license: 'MIT',
  },
  commands: [{
    name: 'generate',
    description: 'Generate components',
    subcommands: [{
      name: 'object',
      arguments: [{ name: 'name', required: true }],
      options: [{ flags: '-o, --output <path>' }],
    }],
  }],
};

export default plugin;
```

## Plugin Management

```bash
os plugin list [--all]           # Discovery across all search paths
os plugin info <name>            # Package metadata and location
```

## Reference Implementation

`@objectstack/cli-plugin-scaffold` demonstrates:
- Project initialization with templates (`os init --template crm`)
- Code generation (`os generate object|view|app|plugin`)
- Configuration management (`os config list|get|set`)

## Type Safety Notes

Zod function schemas require `z.ZodType<any>` for recursive structures and use `unknown[]` for function arguments. Runtime validation remains intact; type assertions documented inline.

## Security

CodeQL scan: 0 vulnerabilities
